advisory.heading: When you write a sentence
advisory.text: Examine only the rules that you add or change for these cases.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/plain-language-rules.md line 27, in the section "When you select the text", "for these cases" can attach to "add or change" or to "Examine", so the sentence does not clearly tell when the limit to added or changed rules is applicable.
advisory.correction: "For these cases, examine only the rules that you add or change."
